title: Decision Lab app marketplace
description: Installable evidence-review, learning-value and commitment-planning apps, organized into collections by use case.

apps.name: Review marble evidence
apps.description: Does a fixed weighing record establish the bag containing the heavy marble? Exactly one of nine identified marbles is heavier. Generate each possible heavy identity, derive each weighing outcome from its pan membership, and retain assignments within the declared global report-error limit, initially one. The required bag question and optional exact-identity question are assessed independently from the generated interpretations. These are hypothetical observations, not a record of physical inspection or permission to act.

domain.label: Canonical examples
domain.description: Reference problems for understanding and testing reusable evidence patterns.

useCase.label: Locate a heavy marble
useCase.description: Determine whether a weighing record identifies the containing bag or the exact heavy marble.

apps.name: Review food-traceability evidence
apps.description: Review which firms belong on a tracing inquiry list before deciding whom to investigate. Compare the product and business-role explanations permitted by the case, derive possible supply connections, and follow each product through the network. Explicitly supplied recall starting points can also be traced and compared. Catalog compatibility supports a modeled inquiry; it does not establish contamination, actual shipments or an issued recall.

domain.label: Food supply chains
domain.description: Food production and distribution networks and their tracing relationships.

useCase.label: Identify firms for a tracing inquiry
useCase.description: Determine which firms belong on an inquiry list across permitted product and business-role explanations.

apps.name: Localize network faults
apps.description: Determine which equipment group or individual node the submitted path reports actually implicate. Compare every permitted failure combination under the declared fault bound, assessed snapshot and reliable path predictor. Separate a stable zone-level finding from individual node failures that remain uncertain before making further diagnostic or repair decisions. The result describes what the record establishes; it does not authorize a repair.

domain.label: Network operations
domain.description: Network monitoring and diagnosis from declared topology and test records.

useCase.label: Locate network faults
useCase.description: Determine which fault zones and individual node failures are established by path-test results.

apps.name: Assess marble learning value
apps.description: Decide whether to buy another comparison before choosing a marble. Compare every permitted complete response policy with the best choice now, using an explicitly reviewed three-state E3 basis, assessed probabilities, payoffs, service likelihoods, fees and completion times. The same choices can be assessed under exact-identity or bag-only payoffs. The source record is retained for review; this app does not rerun the separate historical weighing-evidence calculation.

domain.label: Canonical examples
domain.description: Reference problems for understanding and testing reusable evidence patterns.

useCase.label: Choose a marble investigation
useCase.description: Compare the modeled value of another comparison with choosing now under exact-identity or containing-bag consequences.

apps.name: Assess launch review value
apps.description: Choose whether to commission an early launch-readiness review before reserving a complete operating policy. Compare targeted, full, noisy, missing-result and late reviews against the best no-review policy, using explicit joint readiness probabilities, complete operating consequences, cash requirements and deadlines. A review can improve a reservation choice while a later mandatory gate still controls dispatch.

domain.description: Decisions about preparing, reviewing and committing a scoped product launch.

useCase.label: Choose a launch-readiness review
useCase.description: Compare early review and response policies before a launch reservation deadline.

apps.name: Plan marble delivery
apps.description: Can one complete plan deliver the whole bag containing the heavy marble, sealed and accompanied by its identifying record, within the accepted receipt and prepaid expense limits?

domain.label: Canonical examples
domain.description: Reference problems for understanding and testing reusable evidence patterns.

useCase.label: Deliver the heavy-marble bag
useCase.description: Find a complete plan to deliver the identified bag with its seal and identifying record within the accepted time and expense limits.

apps.name: Plan the first shipment
apps.description: Generate complete, static shipment plans from selectable lots, workers, preparation times, release time, carrier and departure. Check each whole plan against every declared readiness and travel scenario before comparing incremental expense. This synthetic operating snapshot does not infer readiness from business records or reserve stock, staff, authority or carrier capacity.

domain.label: Order fulfillment
domain.description: Plan complete deliveries against accepted readiness, resource, permission, timing and financial constraints.

useCase.label: Complete the first shipment
useCase.description: Compare complete shipment plans that must meet every mandatory obligation across the declared readiness and travel scenarios.

workflows.name: Review a first shipment
workflows.description: Review one delivery commitment, the actual transportation records and complete alternative arrangements. If a timely verification could change the choice, compare its feasible responses with reserving now. Finish with a reviewable proposal and its unresolved conditions.

workflows.name: Review a Walmart first order
workflows.description: Review the four declared readiness questions and compare complete current and EDI-recovery shipment routes. This fictional bounded profile supports a reviewed proposal; it does not establish general retailer compliance or carry out a shipment. Optional readiness learning uses separately reviewed assumptions and exact native operating contexts.

workflows.name: Review a gift-kit commitment
workflows.description: A failed gift-insert preorder rehearsal can have simultaneous print, destination and checkout problems. Review actual scoped reports, establish which corrections are required, and compare complete correction, fresh-rehearsal and handoff arrangements against the deadline, expense, resource and permission requirements. Prefilled inputs are fictional and await review. This review does not establish actual completion or authorize releasing kits.
